🆕 New notice (published: August 13, 2026)

Following a forecast of a linear precipitation band (線状降水帯), Hanno City has issued an evacuation advisory for elderly persons and others in the entire city.

In response, evacuation shelters have been opened at all district administrative centers (全地区行政センター).

If you are elderly, disabled, or otherwise need extra time to evacuate, please leave for a shelter right away.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/emergency/14177.html
summary: ℹ️ Evacuation advisory issued for elderly and vulnerable persons
